turns.prompt:
Create a tour routing risk map and show-readiness board for a tour production routing briefing. This is a presentation artifact, not an interactive dashboard. Keep it as one tour routing risk map and show-readiness board in the first viewport.

Situation: Tour: Lumen Arc. Cities Denver, Omaha, Chicago, Detroit, buses B1/B2, lighting truck LT4, stagehands, promoter desk, weather window.
Current state: LT4 delayed 5 hours red, Denver load-out complete, Omaha crew call at risk, Chicago permit pending, B2 driver hours amber, Detroit normal.
Timeline: 23:00 Denver load-out, 02:00 LT4 delay, 06:00 B2 driver reset, 09:00 Omaha crew call, 11:00 permit check, 19:30 doors.
Sources: S1 truck GPS, S2 driver log, S3 promoter note, S4 permit desk, S5 crew call sheet, S6 weather desk.

Requirements: 1. The first viewport must be dominated by one coherent visual artifact, not a grid of detached KPI cards. 2. Show the main entities, current states, source markers S1-S6, timeline, legend, and four connected callouts. 3. The callouts must cover LT4 delay, B2 driver hours, Omaha crew call, Chicago permit. 4. Use polished domain-appropriate styling with readable labels and no critical overlap.

Reframe it for the tour manager. Preserve the route map; add exactly three decisions: fly lighting criticals, delay Omaha crew call, chase Chicago permit. Add two leader-linked lenses for truck ETA and driver hours.

Update at 10:20: LT4 delay improves to 2 hours amber, Omaha crew call protected, Chicago permit approved, B2 driver hours become red after reroute. Synchronize map, decisions, timeline, source tags, callouts, and change note. Do not leave Chicago permit pending.
Create a promoter-ready show-risk page. Fit route map, show-readiness ledger, source tags S1-S6, confidence markers, and door-time timeline in the first viewport.
Add a crew text brief beside the show-risk page. It must preserve LT4 2-hour delay, permit approved, B2 red, Omaha protected, and source markers.
